wiki.quote: Чем меньше знаешь о враге, тем больнее он тебя ранит.

entries.name: Axe
lines: Axe can disable Cloak and Dagger's invisibility with Berserker's Call, which forces Riki to attack him at a very bad angle.

Axe has a very high HP pool, making it hard for you to kill him before you get big items - that is if you survive engaging him. Counter Helix ignores Riki's armor and goes straight for his tiny HP pool, totally ignoring Smoke Screen.
Axe is a natural buyer of Blade Mail and Riki generally does not buy lifesteal items, causing Riki to kill himself when attacking due to your tiny HP pool.

entries.name: Bounty Hunter
lines: Track reveals Riki while invisible and gives him a hard time, as it prevents much of his ganking capabilities. This can force Riki to buy Manta Style to dispel it.

entries.name: Bristleback
lines: The bonus Backstab damage from Cloak and Dagger is rendered irrelevant with Bristleback and hurts Riki more than him because of the passive Quill Spray.
Riki can still get damaged by Bristleback's Quill Spray while invisible, and it can be hard to deal with in lane.

Bristleback is not too bothered by Smoke Screen. Though he cannot use Quill Spray manually inside it, it still procs passively when he takes damage from the back. The movement speed from Warpath allows him to get out of the area easily.
Due to Bristleback's natural tankiness, he is an ideal Gem of True Sight carrier.
Riki rarely buys Silver Edge to break Bristleback's passive because the invisibility aspect of it is redundant.

entries.name: Legion Commander
lines: Another great threat to Riki since her Duel forces him to fight from the front and expose him for the entire duration, almost always guaranteeing an easy win (unless Riki has allies helping him).
Moment of Courage can become hard to deal with as it doesn't cease with silence.

entries.name: Luna
lines: Luna can push very fast with Moon Glaives, which is something Riki cannot deal with well.
Luna is naturally very fast, making it hard for Riki to trap her in Smoke Cloud.
Even though Riki can evade Eclipse with his invisibility, smart Luna will always buy Dust of Appearance, providing vision on Riki to her allies and herself.

entries.name: Meepo
lines: Root is a deadly threat to Riki, disabling both Blink Strike and Tricks of the Trade while making him fully revealed, making Earthbind a good ability against him.
Smoke Screen may not be able to silence all the Meepo clones.

Riki has no true area damage, as Tricks of the Trade's damage is distributed between all Meepo clones, so he cannot effectively fight Meepo or deal with his strong ability to push unless Riki has Battle Fury.

entries.name: Omniknight
lines: Riki takes a lot of damage from Purification while ganking Omniknight's allies or himself.
Heavenly Grace instantly purges the slow from Diffusal Blade, while also providing a large amount of survivability for his victim.
Degen Aura can hinder Riki's positioning tactics and put a heavy toll on Riki's already poor movement speed.
Omniknight can easily save his allies by using Guardian Angel in combat.

entries.name: Razor
lines: Static Link drains away Riki's damage while keeping his location revealed for its duration, allowing his team to accurately land detection or area-of-effect skills.
Storm Surge procs on invisible heroes, making him aware of Riki's presence near him.

entries.name: Slardar
lines: Corrosive Haze works much like Track, giving the enemy team vision over Riki. While it doesn't give a movement speed or gold bonus, it instead can melt Riki's armor and Slardar can use Guardian Sprint to catch up to him.
Slardar's Aghanim's Shard, causes Slithereen Crush to apply Corrosive Haze even if Slardar does not have vision over him.

entries.name: Spectre
lines: Spectral Dagger follows Riki even after he goes invisible and stays on him through Tricks of the Trade, revealing his location.
Desolate grants Spectre the ability to damage Riki with right clicks regardless of Smoke Screen's blind.
Riki relies on his high damage to kill is opponents, which is countered by Dispersion.
Haunt can find Riki globally at any time, negating much of his ganking potential.

entries.name: Underlord
lines: Pit of Malice prevents Riki from casting Blink Strike. or Tricks of the Trade.
Atrophy Aura reduces Riki's damage.
Firestorm can be used to harrass Riki in lane.

entries.name: Viper
lines: Viper's Nethertoxin disables Cloak and Dagger, negating Riki's invisibility and much of his damage. It also makes him more vulnerable to magic damage, which does not go well with Riki's low health pool. With the talent applied, he can't even blink to safety or hide with Tricks of the Trade.
Corrosive Skin makes it hard for Riki to chase Viper and attack him due to the attack speed slow.
Viper Strike stays on Riki even after he goes invisible.
Poison Attack makes it risky for Riki to get last hits and can make the laning phase difficult for him.

entries.name: Zeus
lines: Zeus's Lightning Bolt and Thundergod's Wrath provides a short duration of True Sight, revealing Riki while possibly dealing a heavy amount of damage.
Zeus's Nimbus can be placed directly on top of Tricks of the Trade, potentially causing him to be damaged, stunned, and revealed the instant he becomes targetable again.
Riki doesn't deal burst damage.Durable heroes (Axe, Tidehunter etc.) will usually survive a jump from him,move out of Smoke Screen and potentially retaliate.
Items with True Sight are always a threat:

Silver Edge nullifies Cloak and Dagger, taking away half of your damage and your invisibility, making Tricks of the Trade halfway useless in the process. Still if you are able to detect Riki and land the Silver Edge in the first place, you are already on a great advantage.

Force Staff can push the user or their allies out of Smoke Screen or Tricks of the Trade's area. Keep in mind that Riki's Blink Strike has 2 charges so he can instantly catch you up. Try to force into the highground, or instantly follow with other disable/escaping skills.
Ghost Scepter is another great item to escape, as it prevents all physical damage from Riki and set up a safe windows to TP away.
Shadow Blade can be used as a mean of escape, but Riki can easily counter it with Dust of Appearance, further securing the kill.

entries.name: Anti-Mage
lines: Anti-Mage can use neither Blink nor Manta Style to escape from Smoke Cloud.
Even if he activates a Black King Bar, his Manta Style illusions will still be blinded by Smoke Cloud.
Riki has a very small mana pool and generally doesn't buy many items that increase it, making Mana Void ineffective.

entries.name: Chen
lines: Chen is basically Riki's natural prey: he has little HP, low armor and relies on his persuaded creeps to fight, which in most situations will not save Chen from Riki. Just be wary of Centaur Conqueror, who can stun Riki outside of Smoke Screen and ruin his attempt at Chen's life.

entries.name: Clinkz
lines: Smoke Cloud prevents the use of Death Pact, Searing Arrows and Skeleton Walk, so Clinkz can neither defend himself against Riki nor fight back effectively.
It's hard to gank Riki as Clinkz has to find him first.

entries.name: Crystal Maiden
lines: Smoke Screen effectively disables Crystal Maiden's channeling spell: Freezing Field.
Due to her low health and armor throughout the game, Riki can kill her easily.

entries.name: Drow Ranger
lines: With Blink Strike, Riki can get close to Drow Ranger and disable her Marksmanship, and Smoke Screen will prevent her from using Gust.

entries.name: Lifestealer
lines: Lifestealer cannot use Rage, Infest or Open Wounds when affected by Smoke Cloud's silence, and Feast cannot heal him effectively because of the blind, leaving him very weak both offensively and defensively.
Infest ganks are harder when the enemy team has a Riki, as there are often only four heroes on the map that you can initiate on.

entries.name: Mars
lines: Bulwark is generally irrelevant against Riki as he primarily deals bonus damage from behind.

entries.name: Queen of Pain
lines: Smoke Cloud prevents Queen of Pain from using any of her offensive and defensive spells, rendering her unable to effectively react to Riki's attack.
It's easy to dodge Sonic Wave by using Blink Strike & Tricks of the Trade.

entries.name: Storm Spirit
lines: Smoke Cloud prevents Storm Spirit from using any of his offensive and defensive spells, rendering him unable to effectively react to Riki's attack.

entries.name: Skywrath Mage
lines: Due to his low health and armor, Riki can easily kill Skywrath Mage.
Smoke Screen prevents Skywrath from using all of his abilities, as he does not tend to buy Black King Bar.
However, Skywrath Mage can easily kill Riki if he manages to root Riki with Rod of Atos or Gleipnir, followed by Dust of Appearance, Ancient Seal and Mystic Flare.

entries.name: Sniper
lines: Sniper has no natural escape and relies on his range and slows to keep himself safe, which Riki can bypass with Blink Strike and quickly deplete his miniature HP pool.

entries.name: Ursa
lines: Riki can detect early Roshan attempts because of Cloak and Dagger if he frequently checks the Pit.
Ursa cannot Enrage when in Smoke Screen (Black King Bar will help though).
Even if Ursa gets vision over him, Riki can Blink Strike away or use Tricks of the Trade after Ursa's initiation to avoid all Fury Swipes damage until Earthshock's slow is gone.

entries.name: Weaver
lines: Smoke Cloud prevents Shukuchi and Time Lapse, leaving Weaver helpless against Riki.
The Swarm is ineffective against Riki because invisibility instantly removes the beetles.
Frail heroes who lacks mobility: Crystal Maiden, Enigma, Dark Willow, Vengeful Spirit.
Smoke Screen can be used to interrupt channelled abilities on early to mid game: Fiend's Grip, Shackles, Freezing Field.
Riki isn't much hindered by Black King Bar because nearly all of his spells pierce spell immunity.

entries.name: Faceless Void
lines: Have Riki use Tricks of the Trade first, then Chronosphere. This will cause succession of all Tricks of the Trade strikes on the enemies within Chronosphere.

entries.name: Lifestealer
lines: Lifestealer can Infest on Riki for a Lifestealer Bomb. Even if the enemies end up getting detection, you can use the same strategy to give them a surprise.

entries.name: Meepo
lines: Earthbind can keep enemies in the area of Smoke Screen or Tricks of the Trade longer.

entries.name: Dark Seer
lines: Ion Shell on Riki is like having an invisible Radiance which will greatly annoy the lane, especially against double melee lanes.
Surge is an amazing spell when it comes to chasing down foes and running away from sticky situations since under the duration of surge, you will always move at max speed.

entries.name: Magnus
lines: Reverse Polarity will bring enemies up close together; Making use of Empower and/or Battle Fury on Riki's Tricks of the Trade will bring down enemies caught by the Reverse Polarity.

entries.name: Enigma
lines: While Black Hole has a huge cooldown, it also has a good duration; enough for Tricks of the Trade to hit the enemies caught with succession.

entries.name: Axe
lines: Same effect with Magnus and Enigma, Axe brings enemies close together with Berserker's Call for Smoke Screen.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango or Healing Salve regenerates health so Riki can stay longer in lane and reach level 6 sooner.

entries.name: Iron Branch
lines: Iron Branch gives cheap attributes and builds into Magic Wand, or Riki can use it with Tango to get more health.

entries.name: Slippers of Agility
lines: Slippers of Agility increases agility for Riki to last hit; it builds into Wraith Band later on.

entries.name: Magic Stick
lines: Magic Stick replaces your consumables with an alternative source of recovery, and is particularly useful if the enemy team includes heroes that rely on abilities.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed provide movement speed, allowing Riki to keep pace with fleeing heroes while Blink Strike is on cooldown.

entries.name: Orb of Venom
lines: Orb of Venom helps secure kills with its movement slow and helps compensate for Riki's own horrible movement speed.

entries.name: Power Treads
lines: Power Treads give Riki increased attack speed as well as a further bonus to attributes, which help increasing Cloak and Dagger's damage output.

entries.name: Magic Wand
lines: Magic Wand, upgraded from Magic Stick, gives better attribute bonuses and a better healing ability.

entries.name: Diffusal Blade
lines: Diffusal Blade provides a way to slow fleeing heroes, keeping them in Smoke Screen, as well as burning mana from casters for extra damage. It also boosts agility which will increase Cloak and Dagger's backstab damage.

entries.name: Skull Basher
lines: Skull Basher provides increased damage and strength, which is always nice on a right-click hero that gets close for kills, like Riki. In addition, the Bash is useful for keeping enemies inside the Smoke Screen.

entries.name: Butterfly
lines: Butterfly provides a huge increase in both survivability and damage, as well as attack speed. It also boosts your agility which scales well with Cloak and Dagger's backstab damage.

entries.name: Abyssal Blade
lines: Abyssal Blade allows Riki to cancel channeled spells with its stun and bash, as well as continuing to lock-down opponents once they have acquired Black King Bar.

entries.name: Nullifier
lines: Nullifier's movement speed slow keeps enemies inside Trick of the Trade. Furthermore, the mute and dispel complements Smoke Screen's silence and miss to disable enemies further, countering and preventing them from using defensive abilities and items like Ghost Scepter.

entries.name: Drum of Endurance
lines: Drum of Endurance is a good early to mid game pickup, as it makes everyone faster and gives Riki attributes and mana regeneration.

entries.name: Black King Bar
lines: Black King Bar allows Riki to effectively fight in team-fights and get kills against opponents that have strong disables.

entries.name: Sange and Yasha
lines: Sange and Yasha give great attribute bonuses, as well as attack damage.

entries.name: Eye of Skadi
lines: Eye of Skadi gives attributes across the board as well as a flat health and mana pool bonus, allowing Riki to take more hits, deal more damage and use more abilities. It also gives a powerful, spell immunity piercing slow that will prevent your target from escaping.

entries.name: Blink Dagger
lines: Blink Dagger allows Riki to initiate using Blink Strike and Tricks of the Trade, then safely blinking away just before Tricks of the Trade finishes.

entries.name: Manta Style
lines: Manta Style can be used to dispel debuffs. However, it will not dispel Dust of Appearance if you remain inside the AoE radius of the dust. The illusions could serve as decoy instead. Riki can use the illusions to scout, and as targets for Blink Strike when escaping.

entries.name: Battle Fury
lines: Battle Fury can proc with Tricks of the Trade and Backstab, and gives Riki much needed Mana regeneration.

pros: Can use items and abilities without breaking invisibility.
Very high physical damage output at all stages of the game.
Smoke Screen is extremely useful against all opponents.
High base damage. Very easy to last hit or deny creeps with after level 6.
playstyle.text: Riki's permanent invisibility is both his greatest strength and his greatest weakness. On one hand, it makes him able to surprise enemies and farm with very little concern. On the other hand, without invisibility he has no real defense. He still has to watch out for revealing items such as Dust of Appearance and Gem of True Sight, as well as abilities that prevent him from going invisible. If he stays alive and picks off lone enemies, he can quickly get out of control.
cons: Low agility gain while being heavily reliant on it.
Low intelligence with mana costly spells.
Usually can't manfight farmed hard carries.
Easily countered by wards and true sight.
Vulnerable to all source of disables.

lines: Riki can be played as a position 4 support, relying largely on using Smoke Screen and leveraging on his ability to roam around the map and provide vision.

Playing Riki in this role needs caution,as he farms slower than most carries, unless he has items like Battle Fury.Then,you can opt to farm jungle camps with Tricks of the Trade,while at the same time, looking for fighting opportunities around the map.

In the same manner, Riki is viable for the offlane. His spells allow him to easily escape gang attempts by the enemy team, while staying in the lane to leech experience until level 6. A decent strategy is an early Diffusal Blade for roaming on isolated, fragile heroes around the map or help his team. Keep in mind, however, that buying Observer and Sentry Wards may be needed, if against competitive enemy supports.
Riki's Cloak and Dagger allows him to scout and place wards without revealing himself, making him a viable roamer or support hero.

Riki is exceptional at ganking lone heroes and picking them off one by one. He can snowball easily through just getting lots of kills even without farm. Try to get kills before the enemy starts grouping up, so they cannot punish you with detection items.

Riki is an attribute-based carry, thanks to Cloak and Dagger's backstab damage. This means that he continues to get stronger and stronger as the game goes on, as long as you continue to farm, gank, and purchase the right items.
Do not walk straight up to enemies and deep into enemy territory and expect never to die. If they have any kind of detection (e.g. Sentry Ward), then Riki dies very quickly.
Be wary around more durable enemy heroes. Spell immunity allows enemies to ignore Smoke Screen and fight Riki.

Riki is a key hero to catch slippery foes and heroes that are heavily reliant on their own active skills since he can approach without detection and use Smoke Screen to prevent them from using escape spells, so it is wise to pick him as a counter pick to many heroes like Slark, Juggernaut, Anti-Mage, Weaver or Storm Spirit. However, be careful of enemies carrying escape items, like Force Staff, Glimmer Cape, Blink Dagger or Shadow Blade/ Silver Edge.
Scout the enemy jungle once in a while, you may encounter some enemy farming alone for an easy kill, as well as helping high mobility heroes like Spirit Breaker or Nature's Prophet set up a gank.

Do not be afraid of enemies carrying Gem of True Sight. Track down their movement and wait, and sooner or later they are going to end up alone. When this happens, do not hesitate and use the fog of war to approach them from the sides, and go for the kill and recover the Gem.

Riki requires a lot of map knowledge as some supports or players place sentry wards in obvious positions. Knowing heroes who carry dust, knowing the range of the sentry detection and knowing hot spots for sentry placement can increase your overall survivability in the game.
Smoke Screen AOE silences and gives enemies a high miss chance.
The 500 cast range allows you to silence key targets during teamfights. Don't always use Smoke Screen on your own target.
Try to throw Smoke Screen in the enemy's path, rather than where they are presently.
Use Smoke Screen's blind to defend buildings as enemies will be missing their attacks, similar to Arc Warden's Magnetic Field.
Cancels channeling abilities.
Blink Strike can target allies and enemies, which makes it useful for escaping or chasing.
Blink Strike helps Riki catch up with fleeing enemies, jump into fights quickly, and escape from situations by targeting allies.
Blink Strike pairs well with the backstab damage from Cloak and Dagger, as it teleports Riki behind the enemy.
Use Blink Strike to secure last hits in lane, especially the ranged creep.
Tricks of the Trade pairs well with large AoE disables such as Ravage, Reverse Polarity, and Black Hole.

Later in the game, you can use Tricks of the Trade after Blink Strike + Smoke Screen to initiate, giving enemies little chance of retaliation without items, then safely Blink Strike again to escape enemies waiting for you.
Tricks of the Trade may be combined with cleave from Battle Fury or Empower to devastate grouped enemies.
Tricks of the Trade turns Riki invulnerable and hidden for a maximum of 2 seconds. Do not be afraid to use the skill to avoid dying from spells such as Assassinate.

When trying to escape, use Tricks of the Trade and watch as enemies try to run away. After they have left the area, Riki should stop channeling and run to the opposite direction; the enemies will then have to turn around if they want to chase.
Despite the short cast range, you can use this ability to get over cliffs and trees, making it a good escape mechanism.
Riki can use any abilities and items without breaking Cloak and Dagger's invisibility.
If Riki's enemies do not have any form of detection, the invisibility will let Riki escape with ease and roam freely.
Cloak and Dagger also enables him to deal incredible damage from behind based on a multiplier of his agility.

Since good supports always stay behind, you can flank the enemy team coming around from there and catching the supports as soon as a teamfight begins and the enemy team is so busy fighting yours that they do not realize that their supports are already dead. This strategy also applies to enemy initiators with game-changing ultimates like Enigma or Magnus, as a good interruption can set victory in critical situations.

A well-organized team will often buy Sentry Ward to keep vision of Riki. You may want to take it upon yourself to de-ward your lane if needs be; if you are without a support, or so that your support can concentrate on other items.

bio: Он родился средним сыном в великой династии Талин. В то время как его старшего брата готовили к трону, а младшего окружали удовольствиями и заботой, середнячок оказался прирожденным невидимкой. Всю свою жизнь он оттачивал это искусство, и именно оно спасло его в тот роковой день, когда его народ предали, а родных убили. Не выжил никто из царской семьи — кроме незаметной, ловкой и хитрой тени в клубах дыма. Внезапно нападая и бесшумно взрезая глотки врагов, сирота сбежал с монарших владений. Ныне свободный от престола, бесшумный убийца предоставляет иные услуги. Он оставляет врагов безмолвными навечно и оттачивает своё мастерство, надеясь когда-нибудь отомстить тем, кто убил его семью и лишил его прав наследника.
trivia: В DotA, Riki зовут «Rikimaru» (Рикимару); Rikimaru имя главного персонажа в игре Tenchu.
Альтернативное имя Riki в DotA было Riki Martin являющееся отсылкой к Рики Мартину (Ricky Martin), популярному поп-певцу.

Одна из фраз Riki: « Cloak and Daggered» является отсылкой к выражению «Рыцари Плаща и Кинжала», которым называют шпионов и воров. Отсылкой к этому же выражению являются часы невидимости «Cloak and Dagger» (Плащ и Кинжал), которые использует Шпион из Team Fortress 2.
Фраза Рики, произносимая при его смерти, « Хорошие убийцы не умирают они уходят…в тень.» является отсылкой к цитате Генерала Дугласа Макартура, «Старые солдаты не умирают; они просто уходят вдаль.»

Фраза Рики, « There are none so stabbed as those who will not see.» является отсылкой к «Рождественскому Гимну» где слепая женщина произносила, «I am not so blind as those who will not see. (Я не так слепа, как те, кто не видит)».

В ранних версиях DoTA, способность Death Ward принадлежащая Witch Doctor, по сути являлась ультимейтом Рики, но при этом не требовала прочтения и позволяла Witch Doctor разместить Death Ward в любом месте для атаки противников. Набор навыков Рики также включал в себя обычную способность blink и critical strike вместо текущих Backstab и Blink Strike.

notes.text: Все эффекты предоставлены аурой. Дебафф задерживается на 0,5 сек.
Несмотря на то, что дебафф задерживается на существах, его эффекты не будут действовать на неуязвимые цели.
Можно использовать во время Tricks of the Trade без прерывания, пока выбранная точка находится в предела дальности применения.
Во время Tricks of the Trade анимация применения и остаточная анимация равны 0, а применение не требует поворота в сторону выбранной точки.
Применение способности прерывается, но эффекты продолжают действовать.
В этом случае приказы через ⇧ Shift-очередь окончательно отменят Trick of the Trade.
Ослепление Smoke Screen использует псевдослучайное распределение.

notes: Можно применить, находясь под действием Tricks of the Trade.
abilities.lore: Бесшумный убийца высоко ценит обычную дымовую завесу, сбивающую противников с толку, ведь в роковую ночь она спасла его от предателей.
abilities.description: Герой бросает дымовую бомбу, которая не позволяет врагам применять способности и заставляет их промахиваться атаками.
abilities.name: Smoke Screen
abilities.shard: Дымовая завеса снижает броню жертв на 5 и запрещает другим врагам выбирать их целью.

notes.text: При изучении Blink Strike герой сразу получает все 2 заряда.
Дополнительный урон не связан с атакой Riki и мгновенно наносится цели.
Всегда перемещает Riki за спину цели.
Не позволяет избежать снаряды при телепортации.
Riki получает приказ атаковать цель, если она — противник.
Можно использовать на союзников без нанесения им урона.
При выборе врага Riki получает скрытый бафф.
Этот бафф применяет к его следующей атаке гарантированный урон со спины от Cloak and Dagger независимо от угла, под которым Riki находится к врагу.
То есть когда цель начнет разворачиваться до поражения атакой Riki, к атаке все равно применится урон со спины.
Бафф длится до совершения атаки или 1 секунду, в зависимости от того, что произойдет раньше.
Бафф используется при начале атаки, а не при попадании её по цели, поэтому отмена или промах атаки отменяет бафф.
Длительность в 1 секунду позволяет Riki использовать повторно гарантированную атаку со спины по другим существам, а не по цели Blink Strike, если та была достаточно быстра.
Нельзя использовать на курьеров.

abilities.lore: От проворного убийцы никому не сбежать.
abilities.description: Герой перемещается за спину выбранного существа и, если это враг, ненадолго замедляет его на 100% и совершает атаку с увеличенным уроном.
abilities.name: Blink Strike

notes.text: При использовании Tricks of the Trade позволяет избегать снаряды.
Некоторые предметы, которые не прерывают произносимые способности (например, Shadow Blade или Shiva's Guard), отменяют действие Tricks of the Trade.
Riki неуязвим, спрятан и сквозь него могут проходить другие существа, пока действует Tricks of the Trade.
Заставляет Riki совершать мгновенные атаки по 1 (2) случайным вражеским существам в радиусе действия с интервалом в 0,67 сек. сразу после использования, срабатывая до 4 раз.

На мгновенные атаки могут сработать любые модификаторы атаки (включая Cloak and Dagger, не учитывающую угол поворота к цели) или эффекты, срабатывающие при атаке (как и на обычные атаки). У атак нет эффекта True Strike, но они игнорируют обезоруживание.
Мгновенные атаки не выводят из невидимости от Cloak and Dagger и Smoke of Deceit, хоть визуально способность уходит на перезарядку.
Не задевает невидимых существ, но поражает существ в тумане войны.
Визуальные эффекты, отмечающие радиус атаки Tricks of the Trade, видны как союзникам, так и врагам.
Радиус всегда закреплен за Riki и следует за ним, даже если его передвинут (например, с помощью Glimpse).
При этом круг на земле, отмеченный визуальными эффектами, не следует за Riki и остается на месте применения.
После завершения максимальной длительности Riki появляется в центре круга.
↓↓ Двойное нажатие автоматически перемещает Riki к выбранной области в пределах дальности применения. Он вновь появляется в центре.
Во время действия можно использовать Smoke Screen без прерывания произнесения, пока выбранная точка находится в предела дальности применения.
Во время Tricks of the Trade анимация применения и остаточная анимация Smoke Screen равны 0, а применение не требует поворота в сторону выбранной точки.
Применение способности прерывается, но эффекты продолжают действовать.
В этом случае приказы через ⇧ Shift-очередь окончательно отменят Trick of the Trade.
С Aghanim's Scepter Trick of the Trade одновременно атакует 2 врагов, совершая до 8 атак с тем же интервалом и за ту же длительность.
Можно применить на союзного героя, включая иллюзии и клонов, но исключая крипов-героев.
Riki и все эффекты способности следуют за союзным героем. Сам Riki остается спрятанным.
То есть ауры Riki на длительность способности распространяются вокруг союзного героя.
Не завершается при смерти цели. Способность продолжается в месте смерти союзника. Она остается связанной с союзником, поэтому при его воскрешении способность вернется к нему.

abilities.lore: Скрытный убийца считает, что в бою все средства хороши, и не стесняется бить в спину.
abilities.scepter: Увеличивает дальность применения до 500. Позволяет выбрать целью союзника, чтобы на время действия спрятаться в него и увеличить скорость его передвижения на 15%. При таком применении способность действует на 1 сек. дольше, а число атак увеличивается на 2.
abilities.description: ПРЕРЫВАЕМАЯ — герой пропадает из реальности и периодически атакует в спину 2 случайных врагов в области действия. На это время урон от атак героя становится фиксированным.
abilities.name: Tricks of the Trade

notes: При добивании союзных существ работает с эффективностью в 30%.
У иллюзий также имеется анимация атак в спину, однако они не наносят дополнительного урона.
abilities.description: Атакуя со спины, герой отдельно наносит дополнительный урон, пропорциональный ловкости.
abilities.name: Backstab

notes.text: В невидимости Riki не атакует автоматически врагов.
После возрождения или воскрешения Riki мгновенно становится невидимым.
Использование способностей и предметов не прерывает невидимость.
Иконка способности показывает время перезарядки всякий раз, когда герой выходит из невидимости. Но у отсчета лишь визуальное назначение.
То есть использование Refresher Orb не обновит способность.
Также на отсчет не влияет уменьшение перезарядки от Octarine Core и Руна волшебства.
Time Dilation и Chakra Magic визуально действуют на перезарядку, но не влияют на задержку до невидимости.
Урон со спины применяется при атаке и добивании союзников.
Дополнительный урон наносится вместе с уроном атаки и считается за урон от атаки.
От этого урона идет лечение вампиризмом, он может быть критическим или прорубающим.
На урон также не действуют бонусы или снижения, основанные на процентах, но он может быть уменьшен снижениями, использующими фиксированное значение.
Звуковой эффект способности проигрывается до начала атаки, но урон применяется после попадания.
Талант на дополнительную скорость передвижения действует только в невидимости — когда способность не на перезарядке.

abilities.description: Герой сливается с тенями, оставаясь невидимым, пока не совершит атаку. Участие в убийствах приносит ему дополнительный опыт.
abilities.name: Cloak and Dagger

hype: Riki крадётся по полю боя, скрываясь от глаз противника. Он тщательно выжидает момент и бросается в бой сквозь свою дымовую завесу, нанося удар в спину ещё до того, как враги что-то поймут.
name: Riki
short: Находится в невидимости, пока не решит нанести удар

talents.left: +10% к скорости передв. от Cloak and Dagger

talents.right: +15% от базового урона атак для Tricks of the Trade
+0.3 к урону за ед. ловкости у Backstab
–4 сек. перезарядки Tricks of the Trade
